question: Who won the Jnanpith Award 2018 - The highest Literary Honour in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitav Ghosh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitav Ghosh** was awarded the Jnanpith Award for 2018, which is the highest literary honor in India.
 
• The award recognizes his outstanding contribution to literature and his extensive body of work, which includes novels, essays, and other writings.
 
• Amitav Ghosh is known for his profound and engaging storytelling, often weaving together history, culture, and the environment.
 
• His notable works include "The Shadow Lines," "The Glass Palace," and "The Ibis Trilogy," among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Jnanpith Award** is presented annually by the Bharatiya Jnanpith to an author for their "outstanding contribution towards literature."
 
• The award was instituted in **1961** and is considered one of the most prestigious literary honors in India.
 
• The recipient of the award receives a cash prize, a citation plaque, and a bronze replica of Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
 
• The award is open to works in any of the 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Previous laureates include prominent writers such as G. Sankara Kurup, R.K. Narayan, and M.T. Vasudevan Nair.
